lemmas.primary_translation: thanks for the time we spent together when we last met; an expression of retaliation or revenge

definitions.text: brukt som hilsen: takk for samværet forrige gang vi møttes
definitions.translation: used as a greeting: thank you for the time we spent together when we last met (lit. thanks for last time)

definitions.text: brukt for å uttrykke at noen gjør gjengjeld eller hevner seg på noen
definitions.translation: used to express that someone is retaliating against or taking revenge on someone
